acceptanceCriteria: the owner chooses (a) or (b) and the decision is recorded
the chosen option is implemented with a regression (b) or documented in docs/DOGFOOD.md (a)
body: From the V1-0493 spike (PR #963, 2026-10-16). After `dogfood-seal`, `status` offers `verify`, which clears the terminal record and leads to a finish that cannot succeed; the worktree stays held until `cancel`, which records non-success over a completion that did succeed. Options: (a) document that the enrolled workflow ends at the bind commit and a sealed worktree needs a fresh worktree for the next enrollment; (b) add a sealed-terminal state with a `workflow-sealed` no-action reason, admitted only for a same-blob rename of the bound CEM, amending accepted LCP-V0-002, 003 and 020. (b) amends accepted requirements, so it is outside the standing auto-accept and needs the owner.
title: Question: should a sealed dogfood enrollment end at the bind commit (a) or gain a sealed-terminal state (b)?
